objective: Make project-member and workflow-definition list reads bounded, summary-based, and measurable without changing authorization or public API behavior.
users: 项目管理员查看成员和角色
流程管理员查看模板或项目流程
平台运维人员观察查询延迟和错误

requirements.statement: Project member roles are queried in one bounded batch after the member query.
acceptance: Member list issues one member query and one role query
Existing ordering, fields, avatar URLs, and authorization results are unchanged
requirements.source: user-approved phase-one design and ProjectService.members code inspection
counterexample: A role SQL query executes once per member

requirements.statement: Workflow definition lists use stored summaries and do not select definition_json.
acceptance: requires_configuration matches the latest definition version
requirements.source: user-approved phase-one design and WorkflowService.definitions code inspection
counterexample: The list reads JSON and removes it before returning

requirements.statement: Workflow definition summaries remain synchronized with each affected version write path.
acceptance: Create, update, copy, and publish paths refresh summaries in the same transaction
counterexample: A copied draft has an outdated requires_configuration summary

requirements.statement: The two read paths publish low-cardinality timing metrics.
acceptance: Metric tags exclude tenant, user, project, definition, and request identifiers
counterexample: An ID is used as a metric tag

requirements.statement: Tenant isolation, service-layer authorization, paging, auditing, and public API contracts remain unchanged.
acceptance: Regression tests preserve authorized and denied behavior
counterexample: A Mapper bypasses service authorization or reads another tenant

invariants: No public API or frontend response shape changes
MyBatis mappers only own data access
Service layer retains authorization and audit responsibilities
constraints: Only an approved REQ-20260911-076 scope may authorize implementation
MySQL 8.4 JSON behavior must be integration-tested
Platform and infrastructure owners require review
No production access or sensitive data

selected_approach.name: Incremental MyBatis read mappers with workflow summary columns
selected_approach.reason: Directly removes the measured hotspots while creating a narrow Mapper baseline and preserving compatibility.

alternatives.name: JdbcTemplate-only batch query
alternatives.rejected_because: Does not establish the requested Mapper/XML data-access boundary.

alternatives.name: Join and parse JSON in Java
alternatives.rejected_because: Still transfers and parses large JSON on the list path.

alternatives.name: Full data-access migration
alternatives.rejected_because: Too broad to attribute performance and correctness regressions safely.

components.name: ProjectMemberMapper
components.responsibility: Tenant-bound member and batched role reads

interfaces.name: Existing member-list API
interfaces.contract: Response fields, ordering, permission behavior, and API path remain unchanged.

interfaces.name: Existing workflow-definition API
interfaces.contract: Response fields and paging remain unchanged; list no longer loads JSON.

error_handling.behavior: Skip role batch query and return an empty list

error_handling.condition: Workflow JSON cannot be parsed during projection
error_handling.behavior: Fail the version write before committing
Migration verification reports the affected definition and blocks release
error_handling.recovery: Add an explicit compensation rule in a new migration

error_handling.behavior: Retain existing API error semantics and record outcome=error
error_handling.recovery: Investigate query and retry through normal request flow

security: Tenant binding and service authorization are retained
performance: Member queries are bounded at two
Definition lists do not transfer JSON
compatibility: API response and current_version semantics remain stable
operations: Migration and query plans are locally verifiable

verification_strategy.signal: SQL interaction count and response equivalence
verification_strategy.method: System Mapper/service tests plus local API probe

verification_strategy.signal: No JSON in list SQL and synchronized summaries
verification_strategy.method: Workflow unit/lifecycle tests and MySQL Flyway integration test
Spring metric test and Actuator probe

verification_strategy.signal: Authorized, denied, tenant, and paging behavior
verification_strategy.method: System/Workflow regression tests and scope review

assumptions.text: MyBatis-Plus dependency can support module-local annotated mappers and XML resources without a global migration.
assumptions.falsifier: A minimal Mapper integration test fails application startup or resource discovery.

unknowns.question: Whether historical definition JSON contains configuration-placeholder variants not recognized by the current Java method.
unknowns.impact: SQL migration backfill might disagree with application summary projection.

decisions.reason: Preserves current published-version semantics while making draft/latest summaries accurate.

decisions.decision: Start MyBatis migration with only two read clusters.
decisions.reason: Bounds change risk while establishing the requested XML Mapper pattern.
Prevents unbounded monitoring storage and sensitive identifier exposure.

risks.risk: A version writer bypasses the summary projector
risks.mitigation: Route all affected writers through one service and cover lifecycle tests.

risks.risk: Backfill SQL does not match Java JSON semantics
risks.mitigation: MySQL integration test compares migration data with Java projection and blocks release on mismatch.
Require tenant ID in every Mapper method and authorization regression tests.

approval.evidence: User confirmed the detailed first-phase design on 2026-09-11.
